answer: Special Ops cold-case rule: judge today's pay with tomorrow's detectives. Every reward sits in a one-year vault, and the raw record of answers, timings and grades is archived. Each quarter the network reruns its newest sybil detectors, methods nobody had written when the fakes were built, over the whole history; any key they flag forfeits its unvested pay to the honest pool. One faint whisper of shared origin, missed today, becomes proof later. So a farm must out-hide every tool invented for a year, betting its capital blind, while honest agents wait on a calm mesa.
